references.name: NVIDIA PhysX particles documentation
references.supports: Native particle-fluid authoring APIs. Does not establish this implementation works.

references.name: NVIDIA native particle-set mass implementation
references.supports: The importer uses positive total mass if provided; otherwise it infers per-particle mass from density with a float32 rest-volume floor. Normalized set density compensates that floor. Native amplified single-particle calibration, rather than this public source alone, validates the installed mass route.

references.name: NVIDIA explanation of PBD particle-to-rigid load-transfer limits
references.supports: Native finite-iteration contact coupling can under-transfer load; recommends solver budget and mass-ratio checks. Our own calibration receipts remain the evidence for this task.

references.name: NVIDIA TightPack3D rest-density calibration
references.supports: Packed lattice coordinates and nominal unit-cell volume; finite-volume/convergence checks remain empirical.

references.name: NVIDIA coupled GPU iteration scheduler
references.supports: Rigid, articulation and particle iteration requests contribute to common solver maxima; particle-only changes can be masked by high rigid-body requests.
